summary: Kabelwerk Rhönsberg GmbH, group-owned cable maker (400 staff); we are 0.85 % of its turnover; it is our sole source for motor cable. The contract has a CU-NOTATION index clause (55 % share), yet its copper is bought forward until March 2027. Price rose 21.9 % since the start and sits 3.9 % over its should-cost. The contract ends 2026-12-31 with 60-day notice. Push the hedge against index pass-through and use its complaint record.
notes: Asked for our expected volumes for the renewal. Contradiction: the index passes market copper to us quarterly while its own copper is fixed until March 2027, so any pass-through before April 2027 is a windfall. Complaint record: 24 in three years, EUR 2,550 recharged) and OTD of 81-89 %.

evidence.quote: they bought their copper forward until March 2027 and said the market price is 'not our reality'
Material covered until March 2027; price valid accordingly.
index clause: CU-NOTATION, material share 0.55, adjusted quarterly
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

levers: index terms: lower share, base reset, deadband
arguments: its own hedge: copper cost fixed until March 2027
avoid: dropping the index entirely (it is in the current contract)
threatening a second source we do not have
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Cite its hedge: no index pass-through or increase before April 2027.
Keep an index clause but cut the material share or add a deadband.
Use the complaint record (24 in three years) as the quality argument.
Answer its volume request with a binding annual volume in exchange for price.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; it kept only 0.27 of its asks historically, but in 2025 it kept 6.0 % of an 8.6 % ask.
